stories.Name_fr: Intégration de l'IA dans les solutions
stories.Explanation: Embedding of artificial intelligence across FIS solutions and operations
stories.Description: As part of its transformation into a platform company, FIS is embedding artificial intelligence across its solutions and operations to enhance innovation and competitive positioning in financial technology

stories.Explanation: Transition to functional operating model to streamline decision-making and enhance collaboration
stories.Description: FIS has shifted to a functional operating model, streamlining decision-making and fostering closer collaboration across the organization and with clients, strengthening competitive position and operational resilience
